review:
Book of Kemet is BGaming's Egyptian book slot with a retrigger twist. It uses 10 paylines, and the book symbol substitutes for any symbol while also paying in any position.

Three or more scatters award 10 free spins with a random expanding symbol that covers its reel and pays even on non-adjacent positions. Every retrigger adds another expanding symbol, up to a maximum of nine, and retriggers are unlimited. That gives long bonuses an escalating feel that standard book games lack. A double chance option and a bonus buy (with a set number of expanding symbols) are available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 7,500x maximum. The RTP is 94.94%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
